grades.quote: The trampoline page mapping at the same virtual address in user and kernel page tables allows userret to keep executing after changing satp.
grades.reason: States the reason directly. The trampoline is mapped at the same virtual address in the user and kernel page tables so that userret keeps executing after satp changes. It also gives context: userret switches satp, and only the trampoline and trapframe are mapped in the user page table.
